mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.document_no, l.id AS line_id, a.id AS stock_action_id, e.id AS execution_id, o.id AS workorder_id, o.bom_id, s.id AS stock_id, l.material_id, l.warehouse_id, l.unit_id, l.batch_no, l.bin_code, l.quantity AS received_qty, LEAST(s.quantity, COALESCE(s.available_quantity, s.quantity)) AS stock_available_qty FROM wm_stock_document d JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id = d.id JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id = l.stock_action_id AND a.document_line_id = l.id AND a.source_type = #{documentSource} AND a.source_id = CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AND a.operation_id = d.post_request_id AND a.stock_id = l.stock_id AND a.material_id = l.material_id AND a.unit_id = l.unit_id AND a.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id AND a.quantity_delta = l.quantity AND a.batch_no = l.batch_no AND (a.bin_code = l.bin_code OR (a.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL)) JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id = d.source_execution_id AND e.id = a.execution_id AND e.product_id = l.material_id AND e.batch_no = l.batch_no JOIN workorder o ON o.id = e.workorder_id AND o.product_id = e.product_id AND o.source = #{local} JOIN material_bom b ON b.id = o.bom_id AND o.bom_id = #{bomId} AND o.material_frozen_at IS NOT NULL AND b.product_id = l.material_id AND b.unit_id = l.unit_id JOIN wm_inventory s ON s.id = l.stock_id AND s.material_id = l.material_id AND s.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id AND s.batch_no = l.batch_no AND (s.bin_code = l.bin_code OR (s.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL)) JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.status = #{enabled} AND w.source = #{local} JOIN material m ON m.id = l.material_id AND m.unit_id = l.unit_id AND m.status = #{enabled} JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id = l.unit_id AND u.status = #{enabled} WHERE d.status = #{posted} AND d.document_type = #{receipt} AND d.direction = #{inbound} AND d.posted_by IS NOT NULL AND d.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND d.post_request_id IS NOT NULL AND l.material_id = #{materialId} AND l.unit_id = #{unitId} AND l.quantity > 0 AND s.status = #{enabled} AND s.quantity > 0 AND COALESCE(s.available_quantity, s.quantity) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_action reversal WHERE reversal.reference_action_id = a.id) AND l.warehouse_id IN #{warehouseId} ORDER BY d.id DESC, l.id DESC
